factories.name: new_get_user_step
factories.description: Read one user account by primary email address, alias, or unique user ID.

inputSchema.description: GetUserInput identifies one account to read.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's primary email address, an alias address, or its numeric unique user ID.

factories.name: new_list_users_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of accounts in the administrator's customer account or one domain, optionally filtered with Google's user search syntax.

inputSchema.description: ListUsersInput selects one page of accounts. Leave both Domain and Customer blank to list every account in the administrator's own customer account.

customer.description: Customer is a customer ID such as C03az79cb, for a reseller administrator; blank uses the administrator's own account.

domain.description: Domain limits the page to one of the account's domains, such as example.com; it cannot be combined with Customer.

orderBy.description: OrderBy is email, givenName, or familyName; blank sorts by primary address.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 500 accounts; zero uses the connection's listUsersPageSize.

pageToken.description: PageToken is the NextPageToken of the previous page; Google keeps it valid for three days.

query.description: Query is Google's user search syntax, such as orgUnitPath='/Sales' isSuspended=false; blank lists every account. Google documents that new data can take up to 36 hours to appear in search results.

factories.name: new_create_user_step
factories.description: Create one account with a generated password nobody receives, tagged with a stable key, so a repeated Step returns the account it created instead of a duplicate.

inputSchema.description: CreateUserInput describes one account to create. The connector generates the initial password itself: no password is accepted, returned, stored, or logged.

familyName.description: FamilyName is the required last name, at most 60 characters.

givenName.description: GivenName is the required first name, at most 60 characters.

orgUnitPath.description: OrgUnitPath places the account in an organizational unit, such as /Engineering; blank uses the top-level unit /.

primaryEmail.description: PrimaryEmail is the new sign-in address in one of the account's verified domains, such as ada@example.com.

provisioningKey.description: ProvisioningKey optionally identifies one logical account across Step executions, such as an HR hire ID. It is 1 to 128 letters, digits, and . _ : - characters; blank uses the Step's Call ID.

recoveryEmail.description: RecoveryEmail is an optional personal address Google can use for account recovery.

recoveryPhone.description: RecoveryPhone is an optional E.164 recovery phone number, such as +16506661212.

factories.name: new_suspend_user_step
factories.description: Suspend one account so it cannot sign in, keeping its data; suspending a suspended account changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: SuspendUserInput identifies one account to suspend.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's primary email address, an alias address, or its numeric unique user ID.

factories.name: new_unsuspend_user_step
factories.description: Restore sign-in for one suspended account; restoring an active account changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UnsuspendUserInput identifies one account whose sign-in to restore.

userKey.description: UserKey is the account's primary email address, an alias address, or its numeric unique user ID.

factories.name: new_add_user_to_group_step
factories.description: Add one account to a group with a role; an existing membership is read back and returned instead of failing.

inputSchema.description: AddUserToGroupInput adds one account to one group.

groupKey.description: GroupKey is the group's email address, an alias, or its unique group ID.

memberEmail.description: MemberEmail is the account's primary or alias email address.

role.description: Role is MEMBER, MANAGER, or OWNER; blank adds the account as MEMBER.

factories.name: new_remove_user_from_group_step
factories.description: Remove one account's direct membership from a group; a membership that is already gone is reported as removed.

inputSchema.description: RemoveUserFromGroupInput removes one account's direct membership from one group.

groupKey.description: GroupKey is the group's email address, an alias, or its unique group ID.

memberKey.description: MemberKey is the account's primary or alias email address or its numeric unique user ID.
